components.name: Wordmark
components.description: The three-stop signal gradient brand mark, used in the header logo.
components.css: .ds-wordmark { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 18px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #06b6d4, #3b82f6, #6366f1); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pill-shaped primary CTA using the two-stop logo mark gradient.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 20px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2563eb, #4f46e5); color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4f46e5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Verdict Card
components.description: The signature result card — large radius, colored ambient glow shadow matched to its own accent.
components.html:

Site is reachable and responding normally.
components.css: .ds-verdict-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.2); border-radius: 24px; padding: 32px; box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(99,102,241,0.08); } .ds-verdict-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 8px 20px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid #d1fae5; background: #ecfdf5; color: #059669; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-verdict-copy { margin-top: 16px; color: #4b5563; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Nav Dropdown Item
components.description: An item row inside the header's hover dropdown, with an icon tile and description.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; background: transparent; width: 100%; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #f0f7ff; } .ds-nav-item-icon { width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 8px; background: #eff6ff; color: #2563eb; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-nav-item-title { display: block; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #1f2937; } .ds-nav-item-desc { display: block; font-size: 12px; color: #6b7280; margin-top: 2px; }

narrative.overview: DownOrUp.net is one instrument panel that renders judgments on two kinds of uncertainty: 'should I do this?' and 'is this website up?' Both surfaces borrow the same visual grammar — a confident gradient signature, pill-shaped controls, verdict-style badges, and cards that glow with the color of their own conclusion — so a diagnostic result and a life-decision verdict read as the same kind of instrument reading, not two different products bolted together. The system trusts a saturated, energetic gradient (cyan to blue to indigo) as its signature — this is a Persuade/Operate hybrid brand, not a quiet enterprise tool.
keyCharacteristics: A saturated three-stop gradient (cyan→blue→indigo) as the brand's signature mark, used sparingly but boldly
Verdict/diagnostic cards use large, soft, colored ambient shadows tinted to the card's own semantic color
Pill-shaped primary controls and nav items; large generous corner radii on card containers
Space Grotesk for display, Inter for body, JetBrains Mono for technical/data readouts

rules.name: The Signature Gradient Rule
rules.body: The cyan-blue-indigo signal gradient is reserved for the brand mark and genuinely electric moments, not general emphasis.

rules.name: The One Verdict Rule
rules.body: Display-weight type at hero scale renders one judgment per view, never duplicated as competing focal points.

rules.name: The Glowing Instrument Rule
rules.body: A primary result card's shadow color always matches its own semantic accent color. A gray shadow under a verdict card is a miss.

dos: Do reserve the three-stop signal gradient for the brand mark and genuinely electric moments.
Do tint a result/verdict card's shadow to match its own semantic accent color.
Do use JetBrains Mono for genuinely technical/measured data, not as a generic costume.
Do keep primary buttons and active nav items fully rounded.
donts: Don't apply a plain gray shadow to a primary verdict/result card.
Don't extend the three-stop signal gradient to body text or secondary UI.
Don't introduce a new accent color outside the established gradient/success/alert set without a confirmed reason.
